confirmedConcepts.meaning: Primary in-run progression measure. Each wave spawns a set amount of enemies and progressively scales Enemy Health & Damage.
Global difficulty level. Higher tiers scale enemy difficulty faster, grant higher coin multipliers, and unlock exclusive milestone rewards.
Specific wave targets within each tier; reaching them unlocks one-time permanent rewards, Relics, and new game features.
Labs unlock research by completing Tier milestones.
Battle/end-game and history metric used as progression record.
Battle history/report list metric for the best wave in a context.

gameBrainMilestoneModel.safePurpose: Give TBI readable wave milestone context and next-checkpoint hints from parsed Tier/Wave without claiming hidden formulas.

milestoneCategories.label: Early setup / unlock pressure
milestoneCategories.interpretation: Use for fresh tiers, low progression, and early analytics wave markers.

milestoneCategories.label: First sustained tier push
milestoneCategories.interpretation: Wave 100+ is a meaningful per-tier checkpoint from app analytics clues; 150/200/250/300/350/400/450 align with Heat-style checkpoint cadence.

milestoneCategories.label: Mid-run pressure band
milestoneCategories.interpretation: Use 500/600/700/800/900 as clean progress anchors; Heat overlay also uses these bands.

milestoneCategories.label: Long push band
milestoneCategories.interpretation: Use 1000 then 500-wave increments for next-goal guidance; do not claim official rewards unless milestone reward data is added later.

milestoneCategories.label: Deep run / farming endurance band
milestoneCategories.interpretation: Use 1000-wave blocks, rate stability, and death cause trends; overlay Overheat/high-wave warnings where relevant.

gameBrainMilestoneModel.nextMilestoneAlgorithm: Given parsed Wave, choose the next greater checkpoint from baseCheckpoints. If Wave exceeds known list, round up to the next 1000-wave boundary. If report is Tournament-tagged, also show next Heat breakpoint from heat_increase_waves until 1000.

tbiUses.use: Show parsed Tier/Wave plus next milestone chip, e.g. Next checkpoint: Wave 8000; Last checkpoint: Wave 7000.
Group run records by tier and wave bands so Andrew can see progression milestones by tier.
Compare Run A/B not just by final wave but by crossing checkpoints and efficiency per milestone band.
Explain whether death happened before/after a clean milestone and recommend the next push target.
Report whether wave/tier catalogue is loaded and whether parsed reports have valid Tier/Wave fields.
Overlay Heat increase waves if Andrew manually tags a run as Tournament.

notConfirmedYet: Exact official reward milestone table per tier was not extracted as a clean readable table.
Exact enemy health/damage scaling formulas were not extracted; only method names and UI meaning were observed.
Exact tier unlock thresholds beyond observed tier2Unlock/tier3Unlock symbols were not confirmed by static strings alone.
Live server tournament settings may change and should not be hard-coded from a static APK without confidence labels.
